signals.name: Payton Pritchard
signals.text: Payton Pritchard signs two-year extension with Celtics Boston Celtics guard Payton Pritchard has agreed to a two-year, $44.2 million contract extension.  Fantasy Impact: The deal includes a mutual option in 2029-30. Pritchard is coming off a career best season and should continue to handle an even bigger role following the departure of Jaylen Brown.

signals.text: Yaxel Lendeborg could open season in Warriors starting lineup Warriors coach Steve Kerr listed the starting lineup he is leaning towards to open the season that includes Yaxel Lendeborg.  Fantasy Impact: The lineup also included Steph Curry, Brandin Podziemski, Gui Santos and Draymond Green. Lendeborg will play a big immediate role as a rookie for Golden State.
